# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with
code in this repository.

## Repository Overview

NixOS + nix-darwin configuration for a homelab: a k3s Kubernetes cluster
(`axon-01`..`axon-03`), workstations, laptops, and microVM guests. Configuration
is composed with the [den](https://github.com/denful/den) scope engine (aspect
resolution with typed `settings` overrides) and deployed with Colmena.

## Auto-Generated Files — Do Not Edit

- `flake.nix` — generated by flake-file from `flake-file.inputs.*` declarations
  scattered across modules. To add a flake input, add
  `flake-file.inputs.<name> = { url = ...; }` to the relevant module, then run
  `nix run .#write-flake`. Never hand-edit `flake.nix`.
- `README.md`, `TOPOLOGY.md`, `diagrams/` — fleet visualizations rendered by
  den-diagram.
- `generated/` — frr BGP configs and Kubernetes manifests rendered from module
  state.
- `.pre-commit-config.yaml` — generated by git-hooks.nix.
- `charts/<repo>/<chart>/default.nix` — nixhelm chart pins managed by
  helmupdater.
- `images/<org>/<name>/` — OCI image metadata (tag/digest/hash) managed by the
  image auto-update system (see `images/DESIGN.md`).

## How Configuration Works (den model)

`modules/den/` is the heart of the repo:

- `hosts/` — one file per host: `modules/den/hosts/<name>.nix`
- `aspects/` — the aspect library. Each category is a namespace: files are
  leaf aspects, directories are sub-namespaces (files prefixed with `_` are
  ignored helpers). Aspect identity paths are relative to this directory
  (e.g. `roles.workstation`, `services.k3s`, `hardware.gpu.nvidia-vfio`):

  ```
  aspects/
  ├── applications/   # browsers, dev (ai, editor, git, k8s, lang, mux,
  │                   #   networking, security, shell), gaming, mail, media,
  │                   #   messaging, productivity, security, shell, terminals,
  │                   #   wayland
  ├── core/           # boot, impermanence, localization, network (syncthing,
  │                   #   tailscale), nix, perf, secrets, security, system,
  │                   #   systemd, users (home-manager)
  ├── desktop/        # gdm, gnome, hyprland, kde, niri, regreet, sddm, style,
  │                   #   uwsm, xdg, xdg-portal, xserver
  ├── devshell/       # devshell routing (e.g. colmena CLI)
  ├── disk/           # btrfs, btrfs-disko, ceph-device-allocation,
  │                   #   xfs-disk-longhorn, zfs-diff, zfs-disk-single
  ├── hardware/       # adb, audio, bluetooth, coolercontrol, cpu/, ddcutil,
  │                   #   gamepad, gpu/, keyboard, laptop, performance, power-mgmt
  ├── kubernetes/     # bootstrap/, hardware/, secrets/, services/ (argocd,
  │                   #   coder, cloudnative-pg, csi-driver-nfs, garage,
  │                   #   longhorn, cilium, coredns, envoy-gateway,
  │                   #   cert-manager, reflector, sops-secrets-operator, ...)
  ├── macos/          # applications/, defaults/, wm/
  ├── roles/          # default, workstation, server, dev, dev-gui, gaming,
  │                   #   gamedev, media, messaging, nix-builder, unlock, vault,
  │                   #   headscale, inference, kexec, kube-tools, cad,
  │                   #   darwin-workstation, bgp-hub, bgp-spoke,
  │                   #   metrics-ingester, creative/
  ├── secrets/
  ├── services/       # ai, alloy, bgp, k3s, media, monitoring, networking,
  │                   #   nix, security, storage, web
  └── virtualization/ # containers, docker, libvirt, microvm, microvm-guests,
                      #   podman, windows-vfio, guests
  ```
- `clusters/`, `environments/`, `groups/`, `users/` — topology entities
  (e.g. `clusters/axon.nix`, `environments/{dev,prod}.nix`, `users/sini.nix`)
- `policies/` — computed scopes derived from topology
- `quirks/` — derived peer/fact data (BGP peers, prometheus targets, syncthing,
  microvm guests, ...)
- `schema/`, `scope-engine/`, `classes/` — den plumbing and option schemas

All `.nix` files under `modules/` are auto-imported via import-tree (files
prefixed with `_` are ignored), so adding a host or aspect file requires **no
flake edits** — it is picked up automatically.

### Host files

Each host file defines two things:

- `den.hosts.<system>.<name>` — host entity: `channel`, `environment`
  (`dev`|`prod`), `system-owner`, `system-access-groups`, `networking`
  (ipv4/ipv6), `guests` (microVM child hosts, see below), and `settings` —
  typed per-aspect overrides addressed by identity path
  (e.g. `disk.zfs-disk-single.device_id = "..."`).
- `den.aspects.<name>` — the host's aspect composition:
  - `includes` — list of aspects (`with den.aspects; [ roles.workstation ... ]`)
  - per-user attributes (e.g. `sini = { includes = [ ... ]; }`) for
    per-user aspect lists
  - `nixos` — raw NixOS options layered on top
  - `home-manager` — extra HM modules

Aspects themselves expose `includes` (sub-aspects), `nixos`/`nix` options, and a
typed `settings` namespace that host `settings` can override.

Per-host state lives outside `modules/den/hosts/`:

- `hosts/<name>/facter.json` — hardware facts (regenerate with nixos-facter)
- `.secrets/hosts/<name>/` — agenix-encrypted per-host secrets

### MicroVM guests (child hosts)

A guest is a full host of its own (e.g. `cortex-cuda`) that is nested inside a
parent via `guests.<name> = den.hosts.<system>.<name>;` in the parent's host
entity. It is resolved under the parent (inheriting its curated includes) and
routed into `microvm.vms.<name>`; hardware overlays (GPU passthrough/vfio) are
layered host-side by `virtualization/microvm-guests.nix`.

## Common Commands

The devshell is entered automatically via direnv (`.envrc` uses nix-direnv;
`direnv allow` on first use) or manually with `nix develop`.

```bash
# Build a host configuration (defaults to the current hostname;
# accepts multiple hosts; --apply = local nixos-rebuild/darwin-rebuild switch)
nix-flake-build <hostname>
nix-flake-build cortex --apply

# Deploy with colmena (tags = environment + resolved aspect identity paths,
# e.g. @prod, @roles/workstation, @services/k3s)
colmena apply --on <hostname>
colmena apply --on @prod
colmena apply-local --sudo

# List all flake environments and hosts
list-infra

# Formatting (nixfmt etc.) and checks
treefmt
nix flake check

# Update flake inputs (GitHub auth) / custom package sources (nix-update)
nix-flake-update
update-pkgs

# Host lifecycle helpers
update-host-keys              # collect + encrypt SSH host keys fleet-wide
nix-flake-provision-keys      # provision SSH keys + disk encryption secrets
nix-flake-install             # remote NixOS install via nixos-anywhere
impermanence-copy             # copy data to impermanence persistent storage
update-tang-disk-keys         # rotate LUKS keys via Tang/TPM2
```

### Kubernetes

```bash
export KUBECONFIG=$HOME/.config/kube/config
kubectl get nodes
```

The `axon` cluster is the `prod` environment; k3s nodes drain on shutdown and
uncordon on boot via the `services/k3s/node-lifecycle` aspect.

## Development Workflow

1. Make changes to modules (prefer editing existing aspects over creating new
   ones).
2. `nix-flake-build <hostname>` to verify the build.
3. `nix flake check`.
4. `treefmt` (pre-commit runs it with `--fail-on-change` anyway).
5. Commit — pre-commit hooks run automatically (treefmt + `nixidy-sync` for
   Kubernetes-related files).

### Module Development

- Aspect identity paths (`roles.workstation`, `disk.zfs-disk-single`, ...) are
  stable APIs — when unsure which options exist, consult the generated
  references in `docs/` (`hosts-options.md`, `host-aspect-settings.md`,
  `kubernetes-options.md`, `environments-options.md`, ...) and `docs/runbooks/`.
- Use deterministic UIDs/GIDs defined in
  `modules/den/aspects/core/users/deterministic-uids.nix`.
- Kubernetes aspects (`modules/den/aspects/kubernetes/`, `modules/den/clusters/`)
  are kept in sync with `flake.lock` by nixidy; the pre-commit hook runs
  `nixidy-sync --skip-secrets` on them.
- Secrets: per-host agenix secrets in `.secrets/hosts/<name>/`. The canonical
  age master identities live in `modules/den/secrets-config.nix`
  (`den.secretsConfig.masterIdentities`) — the single source of truth for
  agenix, nixidy, and sops.

### Adding a New Host

1. Create `modules/den/hosts/<name>.nix` with `den.hosts.<system>.<name>`
   (channel, environment, system-owner, access groups, networking, settings)
   and `den.aspects.<name>` (includes, per-user lists, nixos options) — see
   `modules/den/hosts/cortex.nix` or `axon-01.nix` for templates.
2. Create `hosts/<name>/facter.json` with hardware facts (nixos-facter).
3. Create `.secrets/hosts/<name>/` with agenix-encrypted secrets
   (ssh_host_ed25519_key, etc.).
4. No flake edits needed — the flake is generated and hosts are auto-discovered.

### Nixpkgs Channels

Per-host `channel` option, defined in `modules/den/channels.nix` (each channel
maps to nixpkgs + home-manager + nix-darwin inputs):

- `nixos-stable`, `nixos-unstable` (default), `nixpkgs-master`,
  `nixpkgs-stable-darwin`, `nix-darwin-unstable`

## Repository Structure

```
.
├── flake.nix           # AUTO-GENERATED (flake-file) — do not edit
├── README.md           # AUTO-GENERATED (den-diagram)
├── TOPOLOGY.md, diagrams/  # AUTO-GENERATED fleet visualizations
├── hosts/              # Per-host hardware facts (facter.json)
├── charts/             # nixhelm chart pins (auto-updated)
├── images/             # OCI image metadata (auto-updated)
├── generated/          # Rendered BGP configs + k8s manifests
├── docs/               # Generated option references + runbooks
├── modules/
│   ├── den/            # The den configuration (hosts, aspects, topology)
│   │   ├── hosts/      # One file per host (entity + aspect composition)
│   │   ├── aspects/    # Aspect library by category
│   │   ├── clusters/ environments/ groups/ users/
│   │   ├── policies/ quirks/ schema/ scope-engine/
│   │   └── batteries/  # colmena, nix-on-droid integration
│   ├── docs/           # Generated doc/README content
│   └── flake-parts/    # devshell, treefmt, pre-commit, flake-file infra
├── pkgs/               # Custom packages (nix-flake-build, etc.)
└── .secrets/           # agenix-encrypted secrets (pub/ + hosts/<name>/)
```
